name: deadlock-beltboxes-loaders-CN
title: Deadlock's Stacking Beltboxes & Compact Loaders (CN)
author: Deadlock989, Shane Madden, MasterBuilder, tang-bai
description:
Adds minimalist 1x1 loaders and stacking beltboxes for 5x belt compression for ores, plates and some intermediate products.

This is the CN branch of deadlock-beltboxes-loaders, published under its own mod name (deadlock-beltboxes-loaders-CN). It includes built-in support for Bob's Logistics belt tiers (basic, turbo and ultimate) running at that mod's belt speeds, cheap one-tier-upgrade recipes, and a complete Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) translation.
